text_block_list.text: I'm working in my office when Gold City enters looking exhausted.
choice_data_list: Aren't you supposed to be in class?
Aren't you supposed to be in class?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I promise I'll go to class after, so can you just let me chill here a little?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I don't want anyone to see me slipping. Can't have them worrying about me or thinking I'm not good enough.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I know I can't keep on like this, but… I just can't muster up the motivation… Sigh…
She must be burnt out from all the races I've had her in. It might be better to review her schedule looking forward.
